newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Govt to first receive Australia bank report.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Govt to first receive Australia bank report.

text.p: The final report into Australia's financial system was due to be submitted to the government, but not necessarily published, by March 31, a Treasury spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
The inquiry, established by the government and headed by prominent businessman Stan Wallis, would be released to the public after Treasurer Peter Costello had examined the document, she said.
The inquiry is looking at financial sector issues including foreign ownership restrictions, shareholding limits and prudential regulation.

It is also considering whether mergers should be allowed between Australia's four major banks -- the National Australia Bank Ltd, Westpac Banking Corp, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd and the Commonwealth Bank of Australia Ltd.
